description: The line plot illustrates the relative change across different neural network layer groups for various token and precision configurations. The x-axis is categorical, displaying five layer groups in sequential order: "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis represents the "Relative Change" on a linear scale, with values expressed as percentages. The y-axis includes labeled ticks at -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%, with horizontal grid lines indicating 5% intervals. The plot contains five lines. The "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit" is represented by a grey dashed line with no markers, which remains constant at exactly 0% across all layer groups. The "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit" is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers; it begins near 0% at Layer1-4, remains steady at Layer5-12, experiences a minor dip to approximately -1.5% at Layer13-20, and recovers to end slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit" is depicted by a solid red line with square markers, starting at 0% at Layer1-4, declining to a low of approximately -4.5% at Layer13-20, and rising to end near -0.5% at Layer29-32. The "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit" is a solid light blue line with circular markers that starts at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, drops to a distinct minimum of roughly -13% at Layer13-20, and increases to finish near -1.5% at Layer29-32. Finally, the "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit" is represented by a solid dark blue line with square markers; it begins at approximately -3% at Layer1-4, exhibits a sharp decline to a minimum value well below the -15% tick mark (approximately -24%) at Layer13-20, and subsequently rises to end at roughly -3.5% at Layer29-32.
